notes.title: Our new game ‘Kaichu’ is out now!
notes.content:
Announcing the release of our new game…
[b]Kaichu - The Kaiju Dating Sim[/b]

[previewyoutube=8kLvoXYXxTk;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]KAIJU ROMANCE[/b]
Kaichu is a dating sim about kaiju! You play the role of Gigachu, a gigantic romantic looking for love. Meet six other eligible kaiju and visit twenty-four famous landmarks where Gigachu will answer challenging compatibility questions to decide the fate of your relationship.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1848590/Kaichu__The_Kaiju_Dating_Sim/

notes.title: Tick Tock Isle joins the Time Travel Bundle!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/9252/Time_Travel_Bundle/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10877516/baba3ae5af538047134fd5babbf6182b3e1ca96d.png[/img][/url]

Greetings, curious adventurers and daring pioneers! Tick Tock Isle has joined a group of amazing games in the new time travel bundle!

The doors have opened to times long gone and strange worlds long forgotten. Or would you rather see into the future and find out what awaits humanity? That is also part of this journey. 

Seven amazing experiences are waiting for you in the Time Travel bundle. Take a look:
[list]
[*] Odysseus Kosmos and his Robot Quest
[*] Stories: The Path of Destinies
[*] The Inner World
[*] Omensight
[*] Chronology
[*] Pankapu
[*] [b]Tick Tock Isle[/b]
[/list]
We have combined games from different genres and styles, yet united by the theme of time travel to remind you how diverse the experience can be. 

You will rely on intelligence and cunning to solve challenging riddles. Other times, combining skill and blunt force is the only way to protect what is dear to you. And when that doesn’t work, going back through a time loop over and over again may shine light on the right path. 

Conquer time and space in a whirlpool of worlds so unlike each other!
https://youtu.be/yX1Hd_mt6Qw

notes.title: It s Time You Tried Tick Tock Isle
notes.content:
I’ve had a troubled relationship with video game clock towers. While I adored the setting of Hifumi Kono’s Clock Tower survival horror series of the late 90s and early 2000s, the Mad King’s Clock Tower jumping puzzle in Guild Wars 2, put me off them for life. So many mistimed jumps, so many perilous falls, so many unreasonably narrow floating catwalks that I tell you were IMPOSSIBLE to land on.

Tick Tock Isle [official site] is a wonderfully strange adventure to fix a sodding clock tower on a mysterious island, travelling in time and meeting whimsical townsfolk. It has a demo, and is now the one exception to my anti-time-telling tower rule.

… [visit site to read more]
